hero.desc: myPOS is a complete management tool for small businesses. Sales, accommodation management, revenue statistics, tax filing - all in one app.

features.title: Outstanding Features
features.desc: Every tool you need to manage your business successfully

pos.title: POS Sales
pos.desc: Create orders super fast, manage products and customers smartly
pos.d1: Create orders in seconds, support multiple products at once
pos.d2: Automatic inventory management — stock updates instantly when sold
pos.d3: Search products and customers super fast by code or name
pos.d4: Support cash, bank transfer, QR Code payments
pos.d5: Print receipts directly, save complete order history

lodging.title: Accommodation Management
lodging.desc: Room management, check-in/out, room and service billing
lodging.d1: Manage all rooms, mini hotels on 1 screen
lodging.d2: Fast check-in / check-out, auto calculate daily charges
lodging.d3: Track vacant and occupied rooms in real time
lodging.d4: Record extra services: electricity, water, laundry, meals
lodging.d5: Auto reminders when monthly rent is due

report.title: Revenue Reports
report.desc: Detailed statistics, Excel export, ready for tax filing
report.d1: Visual revenue stats by day, week, month, year
report.d3: Export reports to Excel in 1 click
report.d4: Reports meet small business tax filing standards
report.d5: View top selling products and peak hours

finance.title: Income & Expense
finance.desc: Record income/expenses, calculate profit, detailed financial reports
finance.d1: Easily record all daily income and expenses
finance.d2: Auto calculate real profit = Revenue - Costs
finance.d3: Categorize costs: inventory, utilities, staff wages...
finance.d4: Alert when expenses exceed set budget
finance.d5: Clear and transparent monthly financial reports
